confidence_notes: Low overall. Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregator price data and a 2024 resort menu, not current Mirissa menus. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors are weakly sourced. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; I did not inspect live booking pages or current listings. Menu prices exclude the usual 10% service charge and government taxes. July is low season on the south coast, which pulls accommodation estimates down. The FX value comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the page to verify it. Cocktail anchor is based on 2024 Tangalle resort and Colombo bar menus, adjusted down for beach venues. Wine has no direct Mirissa data and is set at roughly 2.5 times the beer anchor, a local price-relationship assumption.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Sri Lankan south coast price points (Matara, Weligama, Tangalle, Hikkaduwa) and Colombo bar averages for drinks. Mirissa-specific beach-versus-town meal ranges from travel guides. Accommodation tiers are a holistic estimate from general knowledge of Mirissa hostels, guesthouses and boutique hotels, without checking current listings.
